disposition: fire knocked down; primary search started; crews held the scene
summary: A battalion was sent to reports of a house on fire and arriving crews reported smoke showing, then fire coming from the front of a single-story, single-family home. The alarm was reinforced and incoming units were held for assignments while crews worked the fire. Command reported the fire knocked down within a few minutes and started a primary search, with a truck preparing for vertical ventilation.

Units were started to a shooting call at an address on King Street after fire crews already on a medical aid at the same location relayed that a shooting had occurred there and that the victim had an injury. Deputies were sent to take the scene.
Units were sent after a report of a man in his 30s in a white shirt seen on foot firing at a dark gray Toyota SUV. The SUV was last seen northbound. No victim was reported.

area: Calloway Drive at Tuscarora Drive, Bakersfield
disposition: vehicle into a pole; crews cleared the call
summary: A truck, two engines and a battalion were sent to a vehicle into a pole at Calloway Drive and Tuscarora Drive. Crews reported the scene and cleared the call.

area: hospital area near Mount Vernon Avenue and the juvenile justice center, Bakersfield
disposition: subject not found; officers cleared the area
summary: A report of a transient man with no shirt waving a machete and yelling in the area of a hospital and the juvenile justice center was broadcast for officer safety. Officers checked the parking lot and surrounding area and did not find him.

disposition: search underway; family waiting at the command post
summary: Dispatchers advised all units that family at a command post were trying to find a 13-year-old girl whose phone last exchanged a text message with family about 9:08 p.m. and had not moved since, showing just east of one of the buildings. She was described as wearing a white long-sleeved shirt, dark blue jeans and white shoes, and was thought to be with two other teenagers and their families.

area: 900 block of North Chester Avenue, Bakersfield
disposition: report taken; suspects across the street
summary: Officers were sent after a caller reported being assaulted by two females at a location on North Chester Avenue. The caller said the suspects were across the street, and dispatchers noted the call was related to an earlier call for service at the same location.

disposition: at-risk missing juvenile reported; search underway
summary: Dispatchers put out an at-risk missing juvenile alert for a 13-year-old autistic boy reported as a first-time runaway, last seen westbound on a skateboard wearing a black shirt, tan pants and a tan hat.

disposition: heat stayed exterior; residents accounted for; crews cleared
summary: Crews at a residential building reported that all residents had been evacuated and accounted for by staff, and a walkthrough with a thermal imaging camera confirmed the heat stayed exterior and never reached the building.
A priority welfare check was sent to an apartment on Oak Street after a neighbor reported hearing a man yelling at a woman in the unit and saying he was going to hit her again, with the woman crying.
Units were sent to a possible drunken driver in a vehicle sitting in the drive-through of a fast food restaurant in the Rosedale area.
Deputies were sent to a verbal disturbance between a resident and a roommate. Dispatchers confirmed that an emergency protective order had been approved and was on file.

disposition: crews dispatched to a report of fire
summary: Crews were sent to a residence in the 500 block of Cypress Street for a report of fire.

area: park area off San Fernando Road, Bakersfield
disposition: report taken for a follow-up check
summary: A caller reported a man who had been living out of a gray four-door Toyota for more than a month at a park, and said he believed the man may be armed although he had seen no weapons. The caller also reported frequent gunshots heard at night in the area.
Units were sent after a report of a man with no shirt and dark pants lying on the sidewalk on Union Avenue.
Officers were sent to a parking lot on Union Avenue for someone reported to be stumbling off vehicles and possibly passed out a few rows from the exit.
An engine was sent for an unknown medical aid and asked for a translator to get further details.

area: 10100 block of Marco Polo Avenue, Bakersfield
summary: Crews were sent to a medical aid, with an ambulance responding.

disposition: pole sheared; lines low but off the ground; crews held the scene
summary: Crews at a collision scene reported one pole sheared off with lines hanging low but off the ground, and a pickup involved on the inside. The incident commander held the scene while utility and tow work was arranged.
